picks.showTitle: Nitzotzos: Inspiration to Keep Your Spark Alive with Rav Mordechai Burg
picks.title: Nitzavim - You Don’t Need to Become More Jewish. You Need to Become More Yourself.
picks.summary: Most of us assume that Yiddishkeit is something being asked of us from the outside. And when it feels difficult, we take that difficulty as proof that it is not really who we are.But the Torah says something very different: “Ki karov eilecha hadavar me’od”—it is already exceedingly close, in your mouth and in your heart.In this shiur, delivered in Tomer Devorah, Rav Burg explores the startling idea that Torah is not foreign to the Jewish soul. It may become buried beneath habit, shame, or the noise of the yetzer hara, but buried is not gone. Drawing on the Rambam, Tanya, Maharal, Rav Tzadok, a
picks.reason: Deep reflection on Torah as intrinsic to Jewish identity and soul.

picks.title: Episode 551: Elul 2026 IV - Nitzavim (Standing at Sinai) - Lex and Wendie
picks.summary: Elul is the 12th and final month of the Jewish calendar year. Elul Unbound is a Judaism Unbound initiative all about making Elul meaningful, through creative digital modalities. In this conversation, Lex Rofeberg and Wendie Bernstein Lash ask what the Torah portion Nitzavim (from Deuteronomy, meaning "standing") can teach us about what it means to gather en masse -- with other Jews on Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur, or as a broader community beyond just Jews. This Elul episode is the fourth and final conversation in a series of four episodes being released as part of Elul Unbound 2026.----------
picks.reason: A thoughtful conversation on communal meaning and Torah portion Nitzavim's spiritual themes.

picks.showTitle: Entering Rosh Hashanah with Rav Shlomo Katz
picks.title: But My Love For You Will Not End
picks.summary: What does it mean to enter into a bris with Hashem?On the final Shabbos of the year, Parshas Nitzavim gives us the hachana for Rosh Hashanah: אתם נצבים היום כולכם. Stand up. Stand together. Not because we're all the same. Not because we even understand one another. But because every Jew has something that completes another Jew.And then the Torah tells us why we're standing there: לעברך בברית ה׳ אלקיך. To enter into a covenant with Hashem.A bris, the Rebbe teaches, is what two people establish when their love is strong so that the relationship will remain even when there are reasons for it not
picks.reason: Explores covenantal meaning of standing together in Parshas Nitzavim before Rosh Hashanah.

But why would the nation go astray? These are the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, who were chosen by God to be his people. picks.title: Chullin 126 - Like a Rolling Stone
picks.summary:
On today’s page, Chullin 126, the rabbis encounter a mystery buried in two words: golel and dofek. Solving it takes us from Rashi and Maimonides to the burial caves of ancient Israel and the great stones once rolled across their entrances. What can the Talmud teach us about the lost burial practices of our ancestors? Listen and find out.
